clinical_evidence.transcript_text:
Okay, doctor, we're all set in here. I'll give you the numbers when you want them.
Person_1 (NURSE) 0.53-7.75s: Okay, doctor, we're all set in here. I'll give you the numbers when you want them.
Person_2 (DOCTOR) 9.21-14.14s: Thanks. Hello, come in, sit down. What brings you in today?
Person_3 (PATIENT) 15.19-18.09s: Well, I've been having a fever.
Person_1 (NURSE) 19.93-27.54s: Here are the numbers, doctor. Heart rate 107, SpO2 97 percent on room air, blood pressure 119 over 66.
Person_2 (DOCTOR) 28.80-31.57s: Thanks. Does anything make it better?
Person_3 (PATIENT) 33.28-37.72s: Okay, so only paracetamol, and it's not much.
Person_2 (DOCTOR) 39.78-42.45s: Any pain on swallowing as well?
Person_3 (PATIENT) 43.98-53.79s: Yes, for two days. With pain on swallowing, it's mild, honestly. It happens a couple of times a week.
Person_2 (DOCTOR) 55.80-58.99s: And what about ear pain or cough?
Person_3 (PATIENT) 60.37-63.32s: None, as far as I know.
Person_2 (DOCTOR) 65.33-69.46s: Any rash, difficulty breathing or runny nose at all?
Person_3 (PATIENT) 70.53-72.91s: No, not any of them.
Person_2 (DOCTOR) 74.41-76.37s: Is your mobility otherwise okay?
Person_3 (PATIENT) 77.24-78.81s: No, nothing there.
Person_2 (DOCTOR) 79.65-80.98s: Any previous surgeries?
Person_3 (PATIENT) 82.29-84.01s: No operations, no.
Person_2 (DOCTOR) 85.32-87.45s: Any relatives with health problems I should be aware of?
Person_3 (PATIENT) 88.78-90.50s: My mother has diabetes.
Person_2 (DOCTOR) 107.05-115.54s: Okay, any long-term health problems I should know about? I ask because it helps me narrow things down.
Person_3 (PATIENT) 117.17-119.84s: Asthma, for nearly five years.
Person_2 (DOCTOR) 121.90-125.34s: Right, right. Before I prescribe anything, any allergies?
Person_3 (PATIENT) 126.67-127.66s: No allergies.
Person_2 (DOCTOR) 129.67-133.30s: Which tablets or creams or inhalers do you use?
Person_3 (PATIENT) 133.94-141.83s: It's Seretide inhaler, twice a day for my asthma. Paracetamol, 500 milligrams, when needed.
Person_2 (DOCTOR) 155.61-158.37s: Now some background about your lifestyle.
Person_3 (PATIENT) 159.95-170.10s: I drive a delivery van all day. I play badminton on Sundays. I stay with my daughter and her family.
Person_2 (DOCTOR) 171.71-175.58s: So, come over here and I'll have a look.
Person_2 (DOCTOR) 176.43-178.59s: Just relax, I'll be quick.
Person_2 (DOCTOR) 188.80-191.91s: The glands under the jaw are tender.
Person_2 (DOCTOR) 192.76-195.64s: Let me look at this properly.
Person_2 (DOCTOR) 206.75-213.48s: Both tonsils are red and swollen, and there are white patches on the left one.
